cases.name: property-get
cases.source: class C{property int p{get{return 1;}}}void f(){C c={};c.p.get();}
cases.exercise: class Value{int n;init(int n){this.n=n;}int get(){return this.n;}void set(int n){this.n=n;}}class Holder{owned Value p;init(){var value=new Value(41);this.p=move value;}}int main(){var c=new Holder();c.p.set(42);return c.p.get()-42;}

cases.name: private-template
cases.source: class B<T> where T:ExactHeapClass{private owned T[slots] values;}int main(){return 0;}
cases.exercise: class Entry{int value;init(int value){this.value=value;}}class B<T> where T:ExactHeapClass{private owned T[slots] values;init(){this.values=new T[slots];}bool put(owned T value){if(!this.values.reserve(1)){return false;}this.values.append(move value);return true;}owned T take(){var result=this.values.take(0);return move result;}}int main(){var b=new B<Entry>();var entry=new Entry(42);if(!b.put(move entry)){return 1;}var extracted=b.take();return extracted.value-42;}
